purpose: Publish an opt-in mobile camera playground on the existing GitHub Pages site: actual Rust/WASM background feature flow, on-device AI person masking, and a labeled procedural sample mode.

fixed_contract.product: Rear-camera preferred, no microphone, explicit Start/Stop and sample mode, responsive touch controls. AI segmentation excludes person neighborhoods from previous/current FAST plus forward/backward LK tracks. Show image-space median background motion and retained features; do not claim metric distance, 6DoF pose, SLAM or physical tracking accuracy.
fixed_contract.architecture: Add optional camera-tracking dependencies only in spatialrust-web. Reuse existing vision FAST, grid selection and forward/backward LK unchanged. Safe native bounded frame reducer plus explicit copy-named WASM wrapper. Maximum 320 pixels per axis/102400 pixels, 80 retained points, bounded report and two retained gray/mask frames. Reject malformed input and non-monotonic times before mutation; gaps reseed. No core/GPU/vision algorithm changes.
fixed_contract.lifecycle: Single in-flight transferable bitmap, close all bitmaps and inference masks; use a worker for AI and Rust work. Epoch-guard every async camera/worker/frame completion. Stop tracks and terminate workers on Stop, failure, hidden page and pagehide. Late permission resolves are stopped. No camera on load or sample mode. Disabled AI is explicit; AI failure cannot masquerade as active masking.
fixed_contract.privacy: Self-host SHA256/size-pinned MediaPipe 1.1.1 SDK/WASM, model revision 1 and license during Pages build; no remote runtime imports or media uploads. Restrictive CSP including self-only connections; blob module workers inherit it. No recording, analytics or persisted frames. Static asset downloads only. Preserve SDK/model attribution and disclose the mask purpose and limitations.
fixed_contract.verification: Characterize original web tests before implementation, then native dimensions/input/translation/stationary/masking/loss/gap/reset controls; real wasm and model inference in headless Chromium with fake capture only. Test sample and camera startup/stop/denial/late completion, narrow/wide layouts, same-origin asset requests and CSP. Three desktop OS CI plus browser job and Pages deployment provide release evidence; no physical phone or iOS Safari claim without actual device evidence.

verification: Bound owned offline native tests/checks/Clippy/fmt and real release WASM package, reuse installed matching wasm-bindgen CLI, JS unit/lifecycle tests and headless-browser screenshots. Add camera controls to the existing browser conformance job without changing the 131 required names. Commit/push/PR/merge after all checks; verify Pages deployment and live assets before reporting the public demo ready.

resources.preservation: Preserve all 493 prior scientific JSON, 42 frozen native artifacts, pinned references and room outputs. Reuse E-drive Cargo cache; no frozen binary rebuild, sensor payload read/acquisition/copy or real-motion fit. AI SDK/model static assets total approximately 41.1MB, bounded and hash-pinned; no browser download or toolchain install is expected.

remaining_80_percent: Native full-room accuracy and genuinely unobserved motion; both qualifying raw Linux hardware classes; matching canonical measured clock uncertainty and physical frame accuracy; complete canonical mapping/semantic/Viewer/interchange/release acceptance. Successful record-submission traceability does not establish these requirements.
